sar.narrative: Customer C13487, holder of card C13487-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-15 20:30 and 2016-11-26 17:39, 3 transaction(s) totalling $439.61 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $112.37 (3460634, 2016-11-15 20:30), $74.96 (3478561, 2016-11-22 16:11), $252.28 (3489320, 2016-11-26 17:39). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. When contacted, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because: Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-0849, CC-3035, CC-2971. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
